name: MyQuiz
summary:
MyQuiz is a quiz platform for Meta Quest that brings interactive experiences into Virtual Reality (VR) and Mixed Reality (MR).

Create, share, and play quizzes in immersive environments designed for learning, training, events, presentations, and friendly competitions. Participants can answer questions, track scores, and view results while enjoying an engaging and interactive experience inside VR and MR.

Quiz creators can manage their content through the MyQuiz platform and instantly make it available on Me
